findings.finding: The recovery path cleans the attempt and writes completed without reusing the normal completion primitive or revalidating current inputs and authorization immediately before sequence 7.
findings.action: Route normal and recovery completion through one primitive and force current success-bundle binding validation after cleanup immediately before the terminal update.

findings.finding: Success completion has no expected-event CAS or mutex, while the generic event updater permits completed to completed and increments sequence again.
findings.action: Serialize completion on a stable lock, bind the exact publishing event and sequence 6 before atomic sequence 7, and make exact completed reads idempotent without mutation.
